title: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon to share a stage to promote curbs on AI
summary: The poles of U.S. politics are coming together over AI. Sanders and Bannon will appear at the "Pro-Human Assembly" in Washington, D.C., to convince Congress to work faster to curb the impact of AI.
contentText:
